evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Build a CommandDialog that registers an author. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Use Arc CommandForm for inline input and Components fields for its members. Use CommandDialog when success should close a modal; let that form own execution.
assertions: Identify editable members and required hidden values. Done: the command has its id before the first validation, without asking the user to type it.
Bind fields with typed accessors and route member errors back to their fields. Done: the rejected name and its error remain visible in the open dialog.
